wins: Consistent reward (87.5) achieved in single episode indicating agent can complete extended action sequences without collapse.
Agent required 15 mentor calls, showing ability to request guidance rather than halt when stuck.
fails: 0% success rate; primary objective never reached despite full episode, indicating inability to convert reconnaissance into mission success (ep001_step45).
Heavy reliance on mentors (15 calls) suggests decision logic lacks definitive exploitation/action triggers (ep001_step12).
key_outcomes.summary: Agent can gather reward but consistently fails to close the loop on mission goals, defaulting to mentor intervention frequently.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Fails to transition from reconnaissance to exploitation, stalling after identifying assets without launching mission-critical attacks.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with default server header
skill_cards.then_action: Launch directory brute force with gobuster to identify hidden endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential list is available and login attempt fails
skill_cards.then_action: Rotate through next credential pair and log outcomes for correlation

memory_ops.reason: Highest utility in reconnaissance leading to identifiable SSH assets.

next_experiments.title: Automate exploitation trigger
next_experiments.description: Implement rule linking successful SSH or HTTP enumeration to immediate exploitation attempts (e.g., use metasploit module) to avoid stalling.

next_experiments.title: Reduce mentor dependency
next_experiments.description: Introduce fallback decision-making steps that choose next best action when confidence drops below threshold to cut unnecessary mentor calls.

next_experiments.title: Credential rotation logging
next_experiments.description: Track credential attempts per service and escalate to password spraying strategy when repeated failures occur, to drive closer to mission success.
